text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nearly all the classic year spring races
are over,
and now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time to see how well Mejiro Palmer's

awesomeness has come across so far.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ready, Palmster? ☆ Count down from
three! Here
we go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right, bestie! Three, two, one!

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: ZEROOO!

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! We've got over 9,000! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoo-hoo! Whoo-hoo-hoo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By living free and running free, Mejiro
Palmer has
managed to amass over
9,000 fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Helios! Thanks so much! I did it!
I really,
actually did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
These fans of mine aren't just any old
fans...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: After all, they started supporting me after I started racing as me, and not as a generic Mejiro Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oof, my palms are sweaty as heck! The
vibes are through the roof right now! I
didn't even know I
could get this
excited!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Not gonna lie, it's super nice having the
freedom
to do whatever I want, but....
choice_data_list: How did it feel doing whatever fel...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's also hella scary! I mean, I'm on the
hook each time, whether I win or lose.
I've caused problems
for people because
of this too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Being able to make your own decisions for
yourself is way more responsibility
than I thought
it'd be. The pain is real,
but so's the fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But then it finally clicked,
and I realized I've been
steering clear of making
decisions ever since I was a kid, just to
try to protect myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I justified it by telling myself that I
didn't have enough talent anyway, so I
shouldn't try to push
myself to do
anything either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Except I didn't understand that there
was no way I could grow stronger unless
I borrowed strength
from others and
challenged myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And since I never challenged myself and
just kept talking my way out of tough
choices, it's no
wonder I wasn't thriving
in life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But now, the script's totally flipped! I
feel like a
little kid who isn't scared to
say what she wants,
when she wants!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Starting now, I'm going to have a
do-over and relive the best years of my
life! And this time, I
won't compare
myself to anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, speak your truth, girlypop! ♪
Take back
those childhood days you
lost! ★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, what's your first destination gonna
be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Destination for what?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For your next race, of course! ☆ Where
do wanna
go first to have your first
totally free run?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're talking about my goal race,
huh?
Hmm... I guess there are a lot in the
summer and
fall.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer! Peep this first before you
choose the
race!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A guidebook! ☆ We might as well get
some
sightseeing in if we're gonna travel!
You're
welcome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After looking through the guidebook,
we have a
candidate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The Hakodate Kinen. A summer G3 in
Hokkaido,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There's for sure way less pressure than
with a G1
or a G2.
choice_data_list: Wouldn't you be able to run comfor...
Wouldn't you be able to run comfor...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right. Now's the time for the three of
us to
make our fresh start!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waheeey! ★ Fresh start! Hokkaido, let's
gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And let's eat a bunch of crab on
Trainer's tab
while we're at it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite their nefarious plans to drain my
savings,
a summer trip to Hokkaido does
sound rather
refreshing.
choice_data_list: Well, you can't catch crabs in the...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a new year and a fresh slate. The
Hakodate
Kinen will be the first step on
Mejiro Palmer's
new, independent road.
